originalTitle: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look Coming August 27
content: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look will premiere on Netflix Thursday, August 27 at 3 p.m. ET and will also launch on the official Rockstar Games YouTube channel and the Grand Theft Auto VI site at 9 p.m. ET on August 27. https://netflix.com/GTAVI Grand Theft Auto VI is coming November 19 to PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S. Visit https://www.rockstargames.com/VI to pre-order now.
chineseContent: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look 将于 8 月 27 日星期四下午 3 点在 Netflix 首播。 ET 还将于美国东部时间晚上 9 点在 Rockstar Games YouTube 官方频道和 Grand Theft Auto VI 网站上发布。东部时间 8 月 27 日。https://netflix.com/GTAVI Grand Theft Auto VI 将于 11 月 19 日登陆 PlayStation 5 和 XBOX Series X|S。立即访问 https://www.rockstargames.com/VI 进行预订。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 YouTube 热门视频信号，适合用于观察大众注意力、内容叙事、传播主题和跨平台选题机会。
